target_customer: Retail investors, from beginners to experienced self-directed investors, who pay for a Pro or Unlimited subscription
problem: Retail investors spend hours gathering and analyzing company financials in spreadsheets; Stock Unlock automates analysis and teaches investing in one place.
business_model: Freemium B2C SaaS subscription (Free, Pro and Unlimited plans)
product_category: Investment research, stock analysis and portfolio tracking

founders.name: Jake Ruth
founders.background_notes: YC page: about a decade as a software engineer, most recently senior software engineer at Oscar Health. Company story says he built an automation doing in seconds what took Daniel hours.

founders.name: Daniel Pronk
founders.background_notes: YC page: started multiple businesses and runs an investing YouTube channel with over 192,000 subscribers at the time of the page. Education not found.

competitors.name: Simply Wall St
competitors.what: Visual stock analysis with Snowflake diagrams for retail investors
competitors.traction_then: Not found with a dated source

competitors.name: Stock Rover
competitors.what: Data-heavy stock research and screening platform
competitors.traction_then: Not found with a dated source

competitors.name: Finbox
competitors.what: Online equity research platform for value investors
competitors.traction_then: Not found with a dated source

technical_complexity.rationale: Mostly data aggregation through third-party APIs (Finnhub, SnapTrade) plus valuation calculators and a web front end; standard engineering for a two-founder team.

defensibility.rationale: Data comes from vendors that rivals also license and features are copyable; the main edge is the founder's investing YouTube audience as distribution.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent was found to have copied or acquired it; the company still self-describes as building as of its story page.

market_need_then: Retail investing grew sharply in 2020 and 2021 and many beginners sought education; the founders' own story cites a YouTube investing audience and a manual spreadsheet workflow as the pain. No independent market data was opened.

branding.domain_note: Uses stockunlock.com, an exact-match compound of the name.

identity.visual_style: Clean product pages with comparison and use-case content marketing
identity.voice_and_tone: Friendly, 'built by investors, for investors', beginner-welcoming

branding.community_and_virality: Product Hunt listing with 5.0 rating on 13 reviews per search snippet; podcast listing exists; no independent press on the brand found.

brand_strength.rationale: Descriptive-style name with modest independent coverage; the brand leans on the founder's channel rather than a distinct identity.

outcome_analysis: Stock Unlock remains active with an 8 person team and says it is still building. It appears capital efficient with small reported funding, and uses a founder YouTube audience for distribution. No acquisition, shutdown or layoff news was found, and no large round is confirmed.
notes: Funding unverified: CB Insights shows about $1.72M over 2 rounds (seed about $1.22M dated 2022-06 with Team Ignite Ventures) while Extruct shows $125,000 on 2022-01-14 with YC and Team Ignite; no primary source, so no round recorded. The company site states it is backed by YC (W22) and Goodwater Capital but gives no amount or date. Product Hunt lists Nick Puljic as a maker alongside the founders, not recorded as co-founder. Competitor sources are undated company comparison or directory pages, so source_date is null and they may postdate the batch. Two rounds recorded: the seed rests on CB Insights alone and the $125K round on Extruct alone; they conflict with CB Insights' $1.72M total over 2 rounds, so amounts were not summed.
